name: Dutch Street Addresses
description: The street and its house number with the addition (a letter, a floor, a roman numeral, a word), the postcode with and without its space, in lower case and after NL-, the place after it, the country at the end, a Postbus, a care-of line and a street with no number. Original cases written for this corpus from PostNL's addressing guidance, described in our own words; the postcode areas are CBS's (CC BY 4.0).
